# Show the Issues Grid and the COVID dashboard openings in both gallery themes

## Context

The existing light/dark backfill #21942 still has two gallery entries that show the same image in both themes. The shared camera can now capture the GitHub Issues Grid after its visible cells are painted. A fresh capture of the COVID dashboard opens on its four world totals, country ranking and complete World history chart in both native palettes.

## The Problem

`grid-issues` has no light partner enabled. `covid-dashboard` points to `devmode/covidDashboard.png`, an older browser screenshot with a selected country. Its full world chart and footer are cropped at gallery size.

## The Architectural Reality

The catalog owns the base filename and `hasLightCover`. The standard capture pairs insert `-light` before the extension. Pages publishes the four JPEGs; the existing Portal theme switch selects the pair. Both examples have legacy action/crop entries in `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.json` that describe a different interaction from their current opening.

## The Fix

Publish one media batch for the two records. Migrate the dashboard to `devmode/covid-dashboard-14.jpg`, enable both pairs in the Grid & Table and Apps records, and remove their obsolete capture recipes. The previous public dashboard PNG remains reachable for existing links.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The normal camera produces a native dark and light opening for each example at 1280 × 720, without any click, selection or scroll. The Issues Grid shows populated, wrapped rows. The dashboard shows its totals and full World chart.
- [ ] All four Pages JPEGs are published and match the reviewed bytes before the Engine flags are activated.
- [ ] The actual Portal selects and decodes each new image when switching themes at desktop and phone widths. The dashboard uses its canonical JPEG path; the existing Issues Grid path is preserved.

## Related

Part of #21942. The three prior publication children (#21949, #22041, #22050) are closed. The latest 20 open issues, open/closed cover searches and recent team claims were checked on 23 November. This is one ready media batch across two families. Ownership: Emmy is preparing the media and catalog updates together.
